title: FY26 Clouter Creek Middle and Highway Cell Diking
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SAD > US ARMY ENGINEER DISTRICT CHARLESTO
description: DESCRIPTION OF WORK: The work consists of furnishing all plant, equipment, labor, transportation, fuel, lubricant, supplies and materials; and performing all operations in connection with raising dikes and berms and installation of new spillway systems in Clouter Creek Placement Area Middle and Highway Cells, including clearing and appurtenant items. The work is located in Berkeley County, South Carolina. NORTH AMERICAN INDUSTRY CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (NAICS) CODE: 237990 WITH A SBA SMALL BUSINESS SIZE OF $45M. THIS ACQUISITION IS A TOTAL 100% SMALL BUSINESS SET-ASIDE. This solicitation is hereby posted as of 5 August 2026. The purpose of this Amendment 0001 is to reissue the solicitation due to changes in requirements. All interested parties whom meet the requirements in Section 2.1 are eligible for consideration. This Amendment 0001 is hereby posted as of 27 October 2026. The purpose of this Amendment 0002 is to include the wage determination reference, provide updated Specifications and Plans, add a option clause for the addition of options as well to extend the proposal due date. This Amendment 0002 is hereby posted as of 23 November 2026.
